summary: Final regression sweep for BidVex iter230 (Meta Pixel hook + Google compliance pages + JSON-LD) and iter231 (Google Merchant XML feed + locked contact info). Backend: 235 pytest tests PASS across the 7 regression files (1 stale-but-expected failure on test_csv_contains_seed_rows_in_unfiltered_feed because real catalog now exceeds the seed-padding threshold). Live XML feed at /api/feeds/google validated end-to-end (RSS 2.0 + xmlns:g, every <g:id> = raw listing UUID with NO BIDVEX- prefix, <g:price_type>auction</g:price_type>, <g:availability>in_stock</g:availability>, <g:identifier_exists>no</g:identifier_exists>, filters ?province, ?limit honoured, custom X-Feed-Cache: MISS header present). Facebook CSV + JSON + meta endpoints all 200 with raw UUID IDs. Frontend: /refund-policy, /contact-us, all 3 redirects (/refunds, /returns, /contact), 4-column footer with all data-testids, payment-success page, and marketplace home — every smoke check passes with 0 console errors. Detail pages (vehicles, storage-auctions, multi-item-listing) load with status 200 and gracefully render NotFound fallback (preview DB has 0 records for those three types and the 5 marketplace listings don't resolve at the detail-page API layer) — no React crashes, no pageerrors, Meta Pixel hook does not throw. Source-level wiring of useMetaPixelTracking + ListingJsonLd + AggregateOffer/Offer branching confirmed via grep. Zero stale '555 Rue King' or 'J1H 1R8' strings anywhere in /app/frontend/src or /app/backend.

minor.issue: Backend code correctly sets Cache-Control: public, max-age=900 (feeds.py:302) but the preview ingress / Cloudflare rewrites it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' on egress. X-Feed-Cache (MISS/HIT) custom header survives. This is an env-level CDN override, NOT a code regression. Recommend confirming Cache-Control passes through on production bidvex.com via origin-only curl during deploy.

Stale assertion: expects BIDVEX-SEED- pad rows in the CSV but the live preview catalog now has 5 real listings (exactly seed_padded=0 per /meta endpoint), so seed padding correctly does not kick in. Update the test to either seed exactly <5 real listings or accept seed_padded==0 as a valid state.
